tess-partnerships: Quick coordination - NimbusEdge wants to publish their IoT gateway in the marketplace. They have a fresh SOC2 report and a commercial pentest report. ApexSI (chris) will provide artifacts. We need the exact formats, redaction rules, and presign workflow so we can ingest and keep the announcement embargoed until legal signs off. @alan-security @maria-legal

alan-security: From Sec - required artifacts: signed SOC2 PDF (with scope page), pentest executive summary (PDF) that only enumerates high/med/low counts, full raw scan exports (e.g., Nessus, Burp, Trivy) as native files, and a firmware attestation PDF describing signing key provenance. Raw logs must be delivered via presigned S3 links, and an evidence handling NDA must be in place before we accept raw logs. Redaction: remove customer data, obfuscate internal private IPs in screenshots unless absolutely needed. Preferred presign TTL: 259200 (3 days). Please include sha256 checksums.

lee-eng: Ingest details - target path: s3://marketplace-evidence/nimbusedge/<artifact-type>/<partner>_<artifact>_<date>.<ext>. Example: nimbusedge_penlogs_2025-05-12.tar.gz. Include a metadata.txt (plain text) with fields: source, scanner, scan_date, sha256, artifact_type, uploader. Multipart uploads allowed for files >100MB. We'll auto-run an ingestion lambda that verifies checksums and tags artifacts. If you want us to generate presigned URLs, we can create them and email links.

maria-legal: Legal needs executed NDA or partner-signed data-handling attestation before we accept raw logs. For public messaging allowed at launch: "SOC2 audited" and "penetration test completed by [vendor]". Do not publish vulnerability details or screenshots. Retention policy: default 12 months; extension requires contract amendment. Please include signer name, title, and signature date on attestation. I'll share the evidence-handling addendum template.

chris-apexsi: Got it. Plan to upload: pentest-summary.pdf (exec summary), raw-logs_native/ (native files), firmware-attestation.pdf, metadata.txt. Two quick Qs: 1) TTL 3 days ok? 2) do you want native files only or native + consolidated tar.gz? Native is preferred for triage. Also is partner-signed attestation sufficient or do you require a notarized firmware signature?

alan-security: TTL 3 days is fine. Native formats preferred; a consolidated tar.gz for archive is fine too. Partner-signed attestation PDF is acceptable for initial listing; if we later rely on runtime verification we may request certificate chains or notarized evidence. If firmware signing is hardware-backed, include that detail and any cert fingerprints.

tess-partnerships: @chris-apexsi please upload separated artifacts (pentest-summary.pdf, raw-logs_native.tar.gz, firmware-attestation.pdf, metadata.txt). @maria-legal @alan-security confirm no notarization required for initial launch?

maria-legal: Confirmed - partner-signed attestation PDF acceptable for launch. Ensure the attestation contains signer name, title, and date. I'll DM the addendum + suggested high-level announcement copy.

tess-partnerships: Timeline: ApexSI uploads by Mon 09:00 UTC; security review Mon afternoon; legal sign-off Tue AM; embargo lift Tue 18:00 UTC. @deploy-bot can you gate the marketplace announcement until legal confirms?

deploy-bot: Hold placed on "nimbusedge-iot-gateway-announcement" until 2025-05-20T18:00:00Z or manual release. Reason: awaiting SOC2/pen-test evidence and legal sign-off. :robot_face:

chris-apexsi: Acknowledged. We'll upload native exports + archive Mon 08:00 UTC and include metadata.txt and sha256 files. Thanks everyone.

tess-partnerships: I'll follow up with a one-pager for the partner that has presign links, filename policy, NDA link, and the addendum. Ping me if anything blocks. :handshake:
